The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department (temporary facility) at 1225 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Planning Commissionâ€™s purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speakerâ€™s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak.
During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speakerâ€™s card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Chair. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Chair may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of TEN (10) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Commission.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the Planning Commission in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Clerk at, or prior to, the public hearing (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).)

1978

  MINUTES

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights Planning Commission
  April 22, 2014

Opening Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  Call  Meeting  to Order — At 6: 00 p. m. Chairman  Black called the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present:  Chairman Larry Black, Commissioners Ray Fernandez, and Alternate Eric
Grimm

Also Present: David King, Planning Commission Attorney; Katherine Leazer, Principal
Planner; and Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk/ Records Manager

Absent:  Vice  Chairman  Dominick  DiMario,  Commissioner  Ross  Owen,  and

Commissioner Greg Stefflre

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Black), and voted 3- 0 ( absent DiMario, Owen, and
Stefflre) to continue discussion of agenda item numbers 5 and 7 to the next meeting.

Action: Moved ( Fernandez), seconded ( Grimm), and voted 3- 0 ( absent DiMario, Owen,
and Stefflre) to receive and file the Monthly Community Development Report, agenda
item number 6.

Regular Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  1  April 22, 2014

Approved As Amended November 25, 2014
 5.  Minutes of March 25, 2014— Regular Meeting
6.  Monthly Community Development Department Report

7.  Resolution 2014-02 Recommending that the City Council Approve the
  Ordinance Amending Articles 4, 7, 8 and 9 of the Municipal Code

Administrative Items

8.  Discussion of Story Pole Policy

Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Fernandez), and voted 3- 0 ( absent DiMario, Owen,
and Steffire) to have discussion of agenda item number 8 at the next meeting and that
staff  prepares  a  draft  administrative  procedure  for story  poles  based  upon  the
recommendations made by Commissioner Fernandez for a policy that would provide
exceptions to story pole requirements based upon criteria that includes that the
applicant can demonstrate that the project has no impacts.

Staff Comments

None

Planning Commission Comments

Requested by: Alternate Commissioner Grimm made a request that staff rewrites the
requirements for the Notices that are posted at the entrance to a project site such that
architectural renderings are required on the Board and suggested this item be brought
back to the Commission at a future meeting'. There was consensus of the Commission
to bring the item back for discussion.

Adjourn Meeting— At 7:20 p. m. Chairman Black adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Planning Commission Approval
